title: AgentDeck
description: I built AgentDeck to turn an old phone or tablet into a dedicated touchscreen controller for AI coding agents. A lightweight desktop host serves the interface over the local network, allowing spare hardware to replace an expensive single-purpose control deck.

title: Check-ins
description: I built Check-ins, a local-first web app for recurring work and study tasks. It tracks target and maximum gaps, flags items that are due or overdue, and keeps a completion history without requiring an account.
